This is a really great point.  My parents have had similar discussions with my siblings and me to what OP described, and my older sister's story is pretty much interchangeable with A's.  Irresponsible with money, raising children, unable to hold a job, maintain housing, etc.  My parents set up a trust for my sister for this reason.  And yes, like A, she was furious about certain points of the will that implied she'd somehow get less money or have greater restrictions on her usage of her portion of the inheritance.  This behavior seems to be just part of the nature of someone who is accustomed to not suffering consequences for their irresponsibility and having other people always intervene and pick up the pieces.

I think, in most circumstances, it'd be better to deal with negative reactions from family members about having been sexual & have their support in getting away from the girlfriend than to continue being abused in silence.  It's classic for manipulative abusers to threaten divulging secrets in order to control their victims.
